subject: POC success criteria & trial plan \u0014 Atlas Payments
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: POC success criteria & trial plan  Atlas Payments

Thanks again for the time today  good discussion. Quick recap + proposal for a short POC so we can validate performance and quality against your production prompts. Please review and flag anything missing.

Recap of ask from call:
- Evaluate Redwood inference for transactional task (entity extraction + semantic matching) across latency, throughput, cost, and quality.
- Atlas will provide a representative sample of prompts (we discussed ~2k items).
- Goal: determine whether we can meet performance SLOs and cost targets for a pilot rollout.

Proposed POC plan (2 weeks):
1) Success criteria / KPIs (to be validated):
   - Latency: p50 <= 50ms, p95 <= 220ms at typical request sizes (avg 120 tokens; test also at 512 tokens)
   - Throughput: sustained 100 req/s with concurrent users modeled (burst handling + steady-state)
   - Cost: target <= $0.0025 per token (we'll model expected token mix and batch settings)
   - Quality: >= 90% accuracy on labeled eval set for core entity extraction; hallucination rate < 3% on sample set
2) Evaluation plan:
   - Atlas provides: sample dataset (2k prompts), 100 labeled eval examples, success-priority list for intents/entities
   - Redwood provides: trial environment (hosted/dedicated options), perf runs with representative load, eval reports (latency, throughput, token usage), and quality comparisons against baseline model.
3) Ownership:
   - Atlas: provide sample prompts + labeled eval set (due by Nov 10)
   - Redwood: Lukas to run perf tests and prepare benchmarking; Marissa to coordinate commercial/PO; Jordan to PM kickoff and summarize results
4) Timeline / next steps:
   - Nov 10: Atlas provides datasets
   - Nov 12: Kickoff + test plan walkthrough (30–45m)
   - Nov 13–24: POC run (2-week window)
   - Nov 25: Results review and recommendation

Attachments: Redwood_PoC_Template.xlsx (PoC template), Redwood_Intro_Deck.pdf (high-level platform deck).

Please confirm the proposed criteria and timeline or suggest changes. If this looks good I'll send a calendar invite for Nov 12 kickoff.

 Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@atlaspayments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ana Garcia <ana.garcia@atlaspayments.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & trial plan  Atlas Payments

Thanks Jordan  that matches what we discussed and mostly aligns with internal priorities. Two clarifications from our side:

1) Timeline: Nov 10 for the datasets works. We'd prefer kickoff on Nov 12 at 11am ET  does that work for you and Lukas?
2) Targets: Our procurement/finance team asked us to be explicit on cost SLOs. Ideally we need cost/token closer to $0.002. If your modeling shows ~0.0025 we need to understand levers to reach 0.002 (batching, quantization, reserved capacity).
3) Latency: Our product team requested p95 <= 200ms for typical transactions  can Redwood validate at that threshold as part of the POC?

I've attached a sample of the prompts we'll send (POC_dataset_sample.csv). We'll also include a short labeled set (~100 rows) for quality eval.

Best 
Dana
Dana Ortiz
Product Manager, Integrations | Atlas Payments

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & trial plan  Atlas Payments

Appreciate the clarity, Dana  all reasonable asks. Quick updates based on your notes: 

- Kickoff: Nov 12 at 11am ET works for our team  I'll send the invite.
- Cost: We'll model both hosted and dedicated options. Initial estimate: ~ $0.0022/token with standard batching; with reserved capacity and optimized quantization we can likely approach $0.002. We'll include a sensitivity table in the POC report so you can see exact levers.
- Latency: We'll run targeted perf tests aimed at p95 <= 200ms for the 120-token median case and include 512-token runs to show degradation curves.

Proposed refined KPIs for the POC report (numbers will be measured and reported):
- Latency: p50 <= 50ms, p95 target <= 200–220ms (report both; p95 <= 200ms is the acceptance bar)
- Throughput: baseline 100 req/s sustained (we'll test stepped loads to 200 req/s)
- Cost: report cost/token under each configuration; target acceptance <= $0.002 (we'll present options to achieve it)
- Quality: >= 90% accuracy on your labeled eval set for entity extraction; we'll also report precision/recall and sample failure modes

Ownership recap:
- Atlas: deliver POC_dataset_sample.csv + labeled eval set by Nov 10
- Redwood: Lukas (perf) and Jordan (evaluation) will run tests; Marissa will produce the commercial quote and handle order form

I'll attach a short checklist and will share a calendar invite for Nov 12 11am ET. Lukas  can you confirm you can run the perf matrix the week of Nov 15?

 Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@atlaspayments.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & trial plan  Atlas Payments

Looping in procurement steps so we don't slow the trial: 
- We can run a short 2-week eval on a trial account while commercial/PO is processed.
- For procurement, please confirm expected budget range and whether Atlas prefers a monthly order form or an annual commitment.
- Attached: Draft_Order_Form.pdf (simple starter SOW + payment terms).

If you can confirm the budget ballpark (range is fine) we can pre-populate the order form and speed approval.

Thanks 
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@atlaspayments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ana Garcia <ana.garcia@atlaspayments.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 14:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & trial plan  Atlas Payments

All set  we can provide the 2k prompt sample and the labeled 100-row eval set by Nov 10. Budget guidance: looking to keep ongoing cost under $6k/month for the pilot (monthly billing preferred). That implies we need to be careful on per-token costs during volume testing.

Nov 12 11am ET kickoff confirmed  invited your calendar addresses. We've attached the sample prompts and the labeled eval set to this message. Looking forward to the test plan.

Best,
Dana
